items.name: Straight Sword
items.blurb: Honest steel. It asks nothing clever of you.

items.name: Greatsword
items.blurb: Slow, and it does not care.

items.name: Dagger
items.blurb: Two cuts where one would do.

items.name: Shortbow
items.blurb: A compact ash-wood bow bound for a quick draw.

items.name: Katana
items.blurb: A long curve, and a long grudge.

items.name: Halberd
items.blurb: Reach enough to keep the dead at arm's length.

items.name: Warhammer
items.blurb: Poise is a fiction. This is the argument.

items.name: Twinblade
items.blurb: Both ends are the business end.

items.name: Battleaxe
items.blurb: It was a woodcutter's once.

items.name: Buckler
items.blurb: Small enough to be quick with.

items.name: Kite Shield
items.blurb: A wall you can carry. Your arm knows it.

items.name: Tower Shield
items.blurb: You will not be moved. You will not move.

items.name: Round Shield
items.blurb: Plain, round, and enough.

items.name: Spiked Shield
items.blurb: Defence with an opinion.

items.name: Lantern
items.blurb: Light enough to see what is coming.

items.name: Torch
items.blurb: Fire remembers what steel forgets.

items.name: Parrying Dagger
items.blurb: Held wrong on purpose.

items.name: Ash Staff
items.blurb: Grey wood, warm at the grip.

items.name: Starstone Staff
items.blurb: The stone hums before you do.

items.name: Bone Sceptre
items.blurb: Someone knelt for this once.

items.name: Emberlight Sceptre
items.blurb: It keeps a little of the guiding flame.

items.name: Goldbough Branch
items.blurb: Cut, and still growing.

items.name: Blight Rod
items.blurb: Wet to the touch. It should not be.

items.name: Gorefire Brand
items.blurb: Blood takes to flame more readily than wood.

items.name: Wyrmhorn Staff
items.blurb: Taken from something that objected.

items.name: Frost Spear
items.blurb: A rimed point that slows the next advance.

items.name: Cinder Axe
items.blurb: A furnace edge bought with a slower swing.

items.name: Dusk Chime
items.blurb: Its last note settles into a sheltering hush.

items.name: Kris
items.blurb: A wavering blade that leaves the wound open.

items.name: Stiletto
items.blurb: Thin enough to find the gap in anything.

items.name: Broadsword
items.blurb: Wide of blade, and it clears a room.

items.name: Flamberge
items.blurb: A flame-shaped blade that burns where it passes.

items.name: Rapier
items.blurb: A duellist's point. It answers before you ask.

items.name: Estoc
items.blurb: Stiff and four-edged, made to find the seam in plate.

items.name: Duelist's Foil
items.blurb: Light as a promise, and kept the same way.

items.name: Ashen Claymore
items.blurb: Cooled in ash, and it never quite cools.

items.name: Zweihander
items.blurb: Two hands, a wide stance, and no apology.

items.name: Pike
items.blurb: Long enough that the first blow is yours.

items.name: Scythe
items.blurb: A harvest tool, repurposed. The crop is the same.

items.name: Reaper's Crescent
items.blurb: It takes a little back for every life it cuts.

items.name: Mace
items.blurb: Flanged iron and no subtlety at all.

items.name: Morning Star
items.blurb: The spikes are what it has instead of mercy.

items.name: Flail
items.blurb: The head has opinions about where it lands.

items.name: Maul
items.blurb: Built to break a stance, not a skin.

items.name: Thunder Mallet
items.blurb: Every swing carries a little weather.

items.name: Bearded Axe
items.blurb: The long beard of the blade hooks what it cannot cut.

items.name: Moonlit Katana
items.blurb: Pale along the edge, and patient as the moon.

items.name: Moon Glaives
items.blurb: Two crescents, and the cold follows both.

items.name: Longbow
items.blurb: Tall as its archer, and it reaches nearly as far.

items.name: Hunter's Recurve
items.blurb: Curved to hold a draw all afternoon.

items.name: Hand Crossbow
items.blurb: Small, spanned in a breath, and not for show.

items.name: Arbalest
items.blurb: It takes a winch to span and a wall to stop it.

items.name: Leather Whip
items.blurb: It cracks from a distance and is heard from further.

items.name: Thorn Whip
items.blurb: Barbed cord. It bites back at the hand.

items.name: Iron Knuckles
items.blurb: Four rings of iron, and nothing between you and the argument.

items.name: Beast Claws
items.blurb: Taken from something that no longer needs them.

items.name: Storm Sceptre
items.blurb: It hums when the sky does.

items.name: Grimoire
items.blurb: Margins crowded with someone else's fire.

items.name: Prayer Book
items.blurb: Worn soft at the pages that were needed most.

items.name: Sun Talisman
items.blurb: A small gold disc that remembers noon.

items.name: Bone Talisman
items.blurb: Knuckle and thread. It listens for the dead.

items.name: Wayfarer Plate
items.blurb: The armour you were buried in.

items.name: Ashen Vigil
items.blurb: Blackened at the court that broke.

items.name: Gilded Oathsworn
items.blurb: Kept bright by an oath unbroken.

items.name: Warden Mail
items.blurb: Issued, not chosen.

items.name: Nightweave
items.blurb: Dyed with the dark between stars.

items.name: Eclipse Habit
items.blurb: Worn only when the moon is eaten.

items.name: Starlit Silks
items.blurb: It catches light that is not there.

items.name: Astral Vestment
items.blurb: Cut for someone taller than you.

items.name: Rite Vestments
items.blurb: Plain cloth, plainly kept.

items.name: Ossuary Weave
items.blurb: Threaded through with quiet bone.

items.name: Emberlight Habit
items.blurb: Warm long after the fire is out.

items.name: Pilgrim Wrap
items.blurb: Road dust worked into the weave.

items.name: Gutter Leathers
items.blurb: Quiet leather for a loud profession.

items.name: Nightveil Coat
items.blurb: Dark cloth that swallows the outline.

items.name: Duelist Jerkin
items.blurb: Cut close so nothing catches the blade.

items.name: Shadow Mantle
items.blurb: The hem remembers every alley.

items.name: Bastion Harness
items.blurb: Iron shelter that taxes every step.

items.name: Rimeweave Robes
items.blurb: Cold threads hold the enemy at a distance.

items.name: Waywatcher Coat
items.blurb: A light coat for the long retreat.

items.name: Cinderforged Plate
items.blurb: Hammered while the furnace was still lit.

items.name: Wyrmscale Mail
items.blurb: Every scale was a quarrel the wyrm lost.

items.name: Ringmail Hauberk
items.blurb: Ten thousand rings, and each one remembers a blow.

items.name: Hunter's Hide
items.blurb: Cured on the road, worn for the next one.

items.name: Sage's Robe
items.blurb: Every page it was woven beside is still listening.

items.name: Forsaken Medallion
items.text: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Your first attack each combat also deals {poiseDamage} Poise damage.
items.blurb: Its face is worn smooth, but it still remembers being gold.

items.name: Starstone Shard
items.text: Max HP +{hpFlat}. Mana +{manaFlat}. Magic damage +{magicDamageFlat}. Begin each combat with Starstone Charge and restore {restoreMana} Mana.
items.blurb: A chip of someone else’s genius. It still hums.

items.name: Cutpurse's Coin
items.text: Begin each combat Prepared. Your first attack each combat applies {venom} Venom.
items.blurb: One face buys silence. The other buys speed.

items.name: Gold Figurine
items.text: Whenever you heal, gain {block} Block (even at full HP).
items.blurb: It is very small and very heavy and it loves you.

items.name: Golden Sprout
items.text: At the start of each combat, heal {heal} HP.
items.blurb: A sapling waits inside, patient as grief.

items.name: Brimming Gourd
items.text: Picking it up refills your flasks.
items.blurb: Hollowed, dried, and somehow never empty.

items.name: Whetstone Fragment
items.text: Your first attack each combat deals {damage} extra damage.

items.name: Kindling Charm
items.text: At the start of each combat, draw {draw} extra card.

items.name: Cinder Pouch
items.text: Gain 25% more Cinders from combats.

items.name: Feral Eye
items.text: Elites offer an extra card reward choice.

items.name: Goldleaf Charm
items.text: At the start of your first turn, gain {block} Block.
items.blurb: A single leaf, pressed flat, still gold. It keeps the wind off you.

items.name: Cracked Lantern
items.text: On your first turn each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
items.blurb: The glass is broken but the flame refuses to notice.

items.name: Sacrificial Knife
items.text: Your first attack each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
items.blurb: It was made to open things that were meant to stay closed.

items.name: Cured Hide
items.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {block} Block. Poise threshold +2 (no current consumer).
items.blurb: The beast learned its lesson too late to keep it.

items.name: Ivory Comb
items.text: Every 8th card you play each combat: draw {draw} card.
items.blurb: Someone kept themselves tidy right up until the end.

items.name: Cracked Tear
items.text: Flasks are 50% stronger (rounded up).

items.name: Sealstone Key
items.text: Unknown (?) locations on the map are revealed.

items.name: Fell Warden Brand
items.text: Whenever an enemy is Broken, draw {draw} cards.

items.name: Bloodied Talisman
items.text: Whenever Bleed bursts, the victim loses {loseHp} additional HP.

items.name: Ember Fragment
items.text: Resting heals 15% more.

items.name: Twinned Armour
items.text: Every 10th card you play each combat: gain {block} Block.

items.name: Blight-Touched Idol
items.text: Your first attack each combat applies {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight.
items.blurb: The carving was of a saint. The blight made it a saint of something else.

items.name: Warhorn
items.text: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: One long note, and the old anger answers.

items.name: Vow of Vengeance
items.text: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: Every name you take is a name you carry.

items.name: Pearl of Sagacity
items.text: +1 max Mana. Every 6th card you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
items.blurb: It clouds when you are foolish. It has been cloudy for some time.

items.name: Blessed Dew
items.text: At the start of each turn, heal {heal} HP.
items.blurb: It gathers on the vial overnight, from nowhere, for no one.

items.name: Azure Sigil
items.text: +1 max Mana. The first Skill you play each combat: gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
items.blurb: Painted in a hand that trembled, by someone who steadied at the last stroke.

items.name: Bloodstained Chalice
items.text: Whenever Bleed bursts on an enemy, gain {block} Block.
items.blurb: It fills a little more each time. You have stopped asking with what.

items.name: Goldbough Sapling
items.text: At the start of your turn, if you have no Block: gain {block} Block.

items.name: Wyrm Heart
items.text: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. Shrines and chapels no longer offer Rest.
items.blurb: It still beats. It expects something of you.

items.name: Ancestral Horn
items.text: Power cards cost 1 less.

items.name: Titan's Cinder
items.text: At the start of each turn, gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: A giant died to make this. It is still furious about it.

items.name: Radiant Aegis
items.text: At the start of each turn, if you have Block: gain {block} Block.
items.blurb: It rewards the guarded. It has nothing to say to the reckless.

items.name: Flayer's Censer
items.text: At the start of each turn, apply {crimsonBlight} Crimson Blight to ALL enemies.
items.blurb: The smoke seeks out lungs. It is not particular about whose.

items.name: Vigilant Halo
items.text: Whenever an enemy is Broken, heal {heal} HP.
items.blurb: It hovers a hand above your head, waiting for you to earn it.

items.name: Carrion Talon
items.text: Whenever an enemy dies, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
items.blurb: The flock does not mourn. The flock moves to the next warm thing.

items.name: Ember Idol
items.text: At the start of each turn, deal {damage} damage to ALL enemies.
items.blurb: It has been warm to the touch for a thousand years. It is patient about it.

items.name: Crown of Stitches
items.text: Begin each combat with {strength} Strength and {frail} Frail. New limbs are heavy.
items.blurb: It fits. That is the worst part.

items.name: Warden Horn
items.text: Draw {draw} extra card each turn. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
items.blurb: It sounds without being blown. Something is answering.

items.name: Ash of Remembrance
items.text: Gain {gainEnergy} extra Stamina each turn. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
items.blurb: The dead lend strength. They are not gentle about it.

items.name: Cinder of the Fallen
items.text: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina. At the start of each combat, gain {madness} Madness.
items.blurb: It pays out in the coin of endings. It expects you to make more of them.

items.name: Crimson Covenant
items.text: Your attacks apply {bleed} Bleed. At the start of each combat, lose {loseHp} HP.
items.blurb: The pact is simple: your blood answers for theirs. It is not a fair trade, but it is fast.

items.name: Traveler's Whetstone
items.text: At the start of each combat, gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: It was sharpened by hands that are no longer here to use it.

items.name: Moonlit Vial
items.text: At the start of each combat, gain {block} Block.
items.blurb: It never empties. It never fills, either.

items.name: Warden's Lantern
items.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw {draw} card.
items.blurb: The flame gutters when you are hurt, then burns a little brighter.

items.name: Salted Relic
items.text: Gain 20% more Cinders from combats.
items.blurb: It was buried to keep something in, or something out. No one remembers which.

items.name: Hollowed Horn
items.text: Whenever an enemy is Broken, apply {vulnerable} Vulnerable to ALL enemies.
items.blurb: It sounds only once. Everything still standing flinches.

items.name: Gilded Tear
items.text: On your first turn each combat, heal {heal} HP.
items.blurb: A single drop, hardened gold, wept for someone who never asked for it.

items.name: Watchman's Badge
items.text: At the start of each turn, if you are not Weak: gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: It is pinned to a coat that has seen more watches than the man wearing it.

items.name: Howling Standard
items.text: Whenever an enemy is Broken, gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: It has not fallen in a hundred routs. It does not intend to start with yours.

items.name: Emberwick Charm
items.text: The first time you lose HP each combat, gain {gainEnergy} Stamina.
items.blurb: It burns brightest at the moment you can least afford to slow down.

items.name: Carrion Morsel
items.text: Whenever an enemy dies, heal {heal} HP.
items.blurb: The spire feeds those who feed it. It is not fussy about the manners of the exchange.

items.name: Gravetender's Bell
items.text: Whenever an enemy dies, draw {draw} card.
items.blurb: One toll for each name laid down. The tending is in the counting.

items.name: Sentinel's Oath
items.text: Every 12th card you play each combat: gain {strength} Strength.
items.blurb: The oath is long and the watch is longer. Endurance is its own kind of edge.

items.name: Forsaken Warflag
items.text: At the start of each turn, apply {weak} Weak to ALL enemies.
items.blurb: The colors are all but rotted away. What it musters now answers to no banner but yours.

items.name: Wrath Coil
items.text: Whenever you lose HP, deal {damage} damage to a random enemy.
items.blurb: It winds tighter with every wound and lets go all at once, at someone else.

items.name: Ashen Grip
items.text: The first stance you enter each turn refunds {restoreStamina} Stamina.
items.blurb: The leather remembers every hand that held it, and gives a little back.

items.name: Lodestar Shard
items.text: Begin each combat with {restoreMana} extra Mana.
items.blurb: It points nowhere on any map. It points at the next cast.

items.name: Waxen Seal
items.text: The first time you heal each combat, heal {heal} more.
items.blurb: Pressed once, it holds. Pressed twice, it is only wax.

items.name: Whetstone Pouch
items.text: Your first attack while Prepared each combat applies {bleed} Bleed.
items.blurb: A thumb along the edge before the first cut. Habit, and then not.

items.name: Wayfarer's Knot
items.text: Gain 10% more Cinders from combats. Resting heals 10% more.
items.blurb: One knot for the road ahead. One for the breath to walk it.

items.name: Prismatic Thorn
items.text: Your hits build 25% more Arcane Exposure. Flasks are 25% weaker (rounded up).
items.blurb: It drinks the medicine and leaves the fever bright.

items.name: Restless Clasp
items.text: Flasks are 100% stronger. Resting heals 50% less.
items.blurb: It keeps the medicine close and sleep far away.

items.name: Pauper's Diadem
items.text: Power cards cost 1 less (minimum 0). Gain 35% fewer Cinders from combats.
items.blurb: The crown accepts your future earnings. It never asks what you will eat.

items.name: Basic Training
items.text: Deck editing adds any number of Basic martial cards (unranked).
items.blurb: Drilled until the motion forgets it was ever learned.

items.name: Graduate
items.text: +1 max Mana. Deck editing adds any number of cantrips (unranked spells).
items.blurb: The seal on the scroll is cracked from being shown so often.

items.name: Threadbare Satchel
items.text: Your deck may be 1 card smaller.
items.blurb: It holds less than it used to. So do you.

items.name: Ascetic's Cord
items.text: Your deck may be 1 card smaller.
items.blurb: Knotted once for every thing given up.

items.name: Pruning Hook
items.text: Your deck may be 1 card smaller.
items.blurb: Cut back the weak growth, and the rest bears fruit.

items.name: Scribe's Mirror
items.text: When you pick this up, copy one card you own.
items.blurb: It shows the page, and then it shows it again.

items.name: Emberjaw Token
items.text: Your first Blade hit each combat applies {bleed} additional Bleed buildup.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Cracked War Anvil
items.text: Your first Heavy attack each turn deals {poiseDamage} additional Break damage.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Cinderbound Crown
items.text: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Bleed buildup each combat heals {heal} HP.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Moonwell Lens
items.text: Your first Starstone spell each turn played after spending at least 2 Mana grants {block} Block.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Nightglass Rosary
items.text: The second play of the same Starstone card ID in a turn restores {restoreMana} Mana, once per turn.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Fragment of the Third Sky
items.text: Your third distinct Starstone card ID played in a turn grants {block} Block, once per turn.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Whisperglass Die
items.text: If your first card in combat is a Blade attack, it deals +{chargeDamage} damage.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Purse of Borrowed Shadows
items.text: After your first explicit discard each turn, gain {block} Block.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Ember Alms Bowl
items.text: Your first nonlethal HP offering each turn grants {block} Block after its payment.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.

items.name: Ossuary Prayer Wheel
items.text: Your first credited kill of an enemy with Crimson or Necrotic Blight buildup each combat restores {restoreMana} Mana.
items.blurb: A keepsake of the road through ash.
